build.originalBuildBehavior: ca65 dabg.s -o dabg.o -l dabg.lst; ld65 -C nrom256.x dabg.o -o dabg.nes
build.debugFlagsOnly: The added -g, -m, -Ln and --dbgfile options generate inspection metadata without changing game source.
build.supplementalReproduction: ROM, labels, map and listing matched between fresh builds. The ca65 debug database includes file timestamps and is supplemental inspection metadata.

cartridge.region: NTSC; source says PAL works without speed adjustment
cartridge.graphics: PB53 compressed bytes embedded in PRG ROM; original DecompressCHR uploads to CHR RAM.

sourceFindings.subject: Level records
sourceFindings.fact: LevelParamTable occupies 416 bytes (52 records of 8 bytes); final two bytes are a map pointer; zero selects procedural generation.

sourceFindings.subject: Native map command interpreter
sourceFindings.fact: DecodeLevelMap reads position/command pairs; singles, horizontal repeats, vertical repeats and rectangle fills write LevelBuf, then a zero command records player spawn and returns.

sourceFindings.subject: Collision is independent from graphics
sourceFindings.fact: BlockIsSolid indexes MetatileFlags and returns flags & 4; the player calls this for upward and horizontal obstruction.

sourceFindings.subject: Landing and platforms
sourceFindings.fact: Landing separately compares metatile ID against FirstSolidTop (21), plus platform drop-through state; a single binary collision property does not represent every native behavior.

sourceFindings.subject: Runtime map transformation
sourceFindings.fact: PrettyLevel adds clouds and decorative metatiles; RenderLevelBuf emits tiles and replaces displayed metatiles through MetatileBecomes to canonical runtime types.

sourceFindings.subject: Documentation conflict
sourceFindings.fact: The prose rectangle subtype description disagrees with actual decoder. Source and ROM use LevelData_MetaList[param], including D0 empty, D1 spikes and D4 solid.

sourceFindings.subject: Minimal independent static record
sourceFindings.fact: LevelFinal is original bytes e1 2d d4 00: 14 solid cells at row 14 columns 1 through 14, then spawn (4,13).

licensing.boundary: Independent input and source checkpoint only; no original GPL audio code copied into the NES Forge app. This inventory reports upstream notices without determining legal conclusions.

limitations: No claim of in-app native map import, canonical rebuild or movement acceptance.
Existing A1 parser targets iNES CHR-ROM; this original NES2 CHR-RAM cartridge requires an explicit capability decision, not a silently relaxed parser.
Native solid, top-support, hazards, cyclic blocks, teleporters, actors, scrolling, random decoration and audio must be represented or disclosed independently.
Machine-level routine evidence does not equal original game playthrough, physical hardware or independent-emulator acceptance.
